Title: Self-Leadership and the LEAD™ Framework
Focus: Leading yourself first: the foundation for leading a global team with clarity and intention.
Key Topics:
Self-awareness and leadership identity
Values, strengths and blind spots
Managing energy, focus and time
The LEAD™ leadership framework
Pre-work: Reflect on a recent leadership moment you are proud of, and one you would handle differently.
Reflection Prompts:
What did you learn about yourself as a leader?
Which part of the LEAD™ framework do you want to strengthen first?
What did you try this week, and what happened?
Weekly Challenge: Tell me what you did in the past weeks to lead yourself better. What did you try from your 30-day plan, and what happened?

Title: Practical Leadership Tools
Focus: Turning leadership intent into daily practice with your team and stakeholders.
Key Topics:
Delegation
Giving clear direction
Prioritization
Stakeholder management
Accountability
Pre-work: List your top 5 current priorities and the tasks you could delegate.
Reflection Prompts:
Which tool did you put into practice, and with whom?
What changed in how your team responded?
Where did you get stuck?
Weekly Challenge: Tell me what you did in the past weeks with your Module 2 tools: coaching, feedback, delegation, priorities or 1:1s. What did you try, with whom, and what happened?

Title: Real-World Case Discussions
Focus: Applying the frameworks and tools to real situations from your role and organization.
Key Topics:
Case analysis from real leadership situations
Decision-making under ambiguity
Leading across functions and cultures
Pre-work: Bring one current leadership challenge you would like to work through.
Reflection Prompts:
What insight from the case discussion applies to your own situation?
What would you now do differently?
What support do you need to act on it?
Weekly Challenge: Tell me what you did in the past weeks about your own adaptive challenge. What step did you take, with whom, and what happened?

Title: Leadership Action Plan
Focus: Consolidating your learning into a focused, measurable plan for the months ahead.
Key Topics:
Leadership goals and success measures
30-60-90 day priorities
Support, accountability and check-ins
Pre-work: Review your weekly ratings and note the 3 shifts that matter most to you.
Reflection Prompts:
What are the three leadership commitments in your action plan?
How will you and your sponsor know you are making progress?
What could get in the way, and how will you handle it?
Weekly Challenge: Tell me what you did in the past weeks on your leadership action plan. What moved forward, and what got in the way?
